policy: Every job names the metric or edge-evidence contract it serves and declares cadence, provenance, uncertainty, and failure behavior.

jobs.cadence: Refresh with each UN World Water Development Report and major FAO AQUASTAT irrigation assessment.
jobs.provenance: Official UNESCO/UN-Water and FAO assessments retaining global groundwater depletion range, sector abstraction shares, domestic and irrigation dependence, irrigated-land coverage, irrigation withdrawal losses and reporting-country denominators separately.
jobs.uncertainty: Global depletion estimates vary by method and period; sector shares do not allocate depletion, dependence is exposure rather than shortage, and some apparent irrigation loss is recoverable downstream.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never allocate aggregate depletion to a sector, treat dependence as shortage, count recoverable return flow as destroyed water, or fill missing countries with zero.

jobs.cadence: Refresh when FAO publishes a successor global salt-affected-soils assessment or salinity map.
jobs.provenance: Official FAO global assessment retaining currently affected area, land share, annual crop-production loss, annual farmland loss and population context as separate quantities.
jobs.uncertainty: Mapping, natural-versus-human salinity, older burden syntheses, cropland definitions and uneven national data affect estimates.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never score area at risk as affected, treat all salinity as human-caused, distribute the burden uniformly or fill missing uncertainty with zero.

jobs.cadence: Annual review of UNEP nitrogen and Global Partnership on Nutrient Management assessments.
jobs.provenance: Official UNEP findings retaining reactive-nitrogen loss, fertilizer escape, resource cost, eutrophication inventories, dead-zone accumulation and fisheries dependence separately.
jobs.uncertainty: Nitrogen budgets combine multiple environmental pathways; site inventories are monitoring-dependent lower bounds and fisheries dependence is exposure rather than realized loss.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never convert site counts to area, allocate the global cost to a locality, classify unmonitored coasts, add overlapping budgets or fill missing values with zero.

jobs.cadence: Annual review of FAO and UNCCD global dryland and desertification assessments.
jobs.provenance: Official FAO synthesis of GLASOD/UNEP desertification estimates and official UNCCD land-and-health synthesis, retaining assessment years, direct-versus-at-risk population labels, dryland boundaries and source locators.
jobs.uncertainty: The global area and annual-rate estimates synthesize older assessments with differing definitions and methods; population figures are order-of-magnitude estimates rather than a household census.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; reject changed dryland definitions, units, population labels, annual-rate boundaries or locators; never infer a current-data trend, convert drought alone into persistent degradation or fill unreported uncertainty with zero.

jobs.cadence: Monthly after NASA CERES extends or revises EBAF-TOA Ed4.2.1; validate the product version and available range before every refresh.
jobs.provenance: Official NASA CERES EBAF-TOA Ed4.2.1 source-native global monthly outgoing shortwave all-sky and clear-sky flux arrays, retaining the exact product, variables, sign convention and available time range.
jobs.uncertainty: Clear-sky sampling, scene classification, cloud masking, diurnal sampling, instrument calibration, aerosol above clouds, surface albedo, product revisions and changing cloud regimes affect the inferred cloud radiative effect and its trend.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last validated snapshot and mark stale; reject a changed product version, variable identity, time range, missing month, non-finite flux, sign-convention violation or fewer than 20 complete calendar years; never fill missing flux with zero or substitute total cloud fraction for radiative effect.

jobs.cadence: Annual after the World Bank updates the WDI PM2.5 exposure series; check source metadata monthly.
jobs.provenance: Official World Bank API World aggregate for EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3, retaining the consecutive population-weighted annual exposure series sourced from Global Burden of Disease 2023.
jobs.uncertainty: This is a model-based population-exposure estimate informed by satellite retrievals, chemical transport models and monitoring data; exposure surfaces, population weights, calibration and source revisions affect comparisons.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last validated snapshot and mark stale; reject changed indicator, geography, units, non-positive values, internal missing years or fewer than 20 complete annual observations; never fill missing exposure with zero or substitute country values for the World aggregate.

jobs.cadence: Annual complete-year refresh from NOAA daily v3 files.
jobs.provenance: Official NOAA/AOML Western Boundary Time Series daily Florida Current transport at 27N, retaining valid cable and pressure-gauge replacement flags, source-year locators and the secular geomagnetic-field correction.
jobs.uncertainty: Transport at one section includes wind-driven and overturning contributions; instrumentation, cable calibration, pressure-gauge substitution, geomagnetic correction, missing days and annual aggregation affect comparison.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last validated complete-year snapshot and mark stale; reject missing annual files, fewer than 300 valid days, schema drift or invalid quality flags; never fill missing days with zero or infer the full Gulf Stream or AMOC from this section.

jobs.cadence: Release-triggered refresh with a monthly source and DOI metadata check.
jobs.provenance: Official RAPID-MOCHA-WBTS half-daily, 10-day-low-pass-filtered full-basin-width AMOC transport at 26.5N, aggregated only into coverage-qualified monthly observations and bound to the source NetCDF checksum.
jobs.uncertainty: Mooring recovery and quality-control create a publication lag; sub-annual AMOC variability is large and one latitude does not directly observe every global overturning cell.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last checksum-validated snapshot and mark stale; reject changed variables, units, epoch, fill value or fewer than 60 complete months; never fill missing transports with zero or infer AMOC collapse from a single month.

jobs.cadence: Annual FAOSTAT Food Balance Sheets release.
jobs.provenance: Checksum-bound World aggregate feed and domestic-supply rows for the source-defined Cereals - Excluding Beer basket, with a quantified four-year overlap crosswalk between official historical and current editions.
jobs.uncertainty: Food-balance synthesis, commodity composition, feed by-products, revisions and edition changes affect values; the historical crosswalk is used only for normalization and does not alter current observations.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last checksum-validated current series and mark stale; reject changed World, item, element, unit, year or checksum definitions; never combine undeclared commodity masses, fill missing utilization with zero, call feed use livestock intake or splice editions without overlap calibration.

jobs.cadence: Annual FAOSTAT Food Security and Population release.
jobs.provenance: Checksum-bound FAOSTAT country and territory cereal import-dependency ratios joined to middle-year total population, retaining signed ratios and high-dependency population exposure across 22 complete three-year periods.
jobs.uncertainty: Food-balance uncertainty, informal trade, stock changes, re-exports, food aid, population estimates and overlapping three-year periods affect values; country dependency is not household insecurity or supplier concentration.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last checksum-validated source pair and mark stale; reject item, unit, population element, area-code, period or checksum changes; never clip net exporters, fill missing ratios with zero, use the World net-trade ratio as exposure or infer insecurity from dependency alone.

jobs.cadence: Annual FAOSTAT fertilizer-product release.
jobs.provenance: Checksum-bound FAOSTAT Fertilizers by Product rows filtered to production in tonnes and disjoint country or territory area codes, retaining 15 complete 2002-2023 product-class series separately.
jobs.uncertainty: Official, estimated and imputed flags, confidential output, country reporting gaps, revisions, secondary production and product composition affect totals; the 2024 country panel is incomplete.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last checksum-validated complete product panel and mark stale; reject schema, element, unit, code or checksum changes; never fill missing output with zero, mix country and aggregate rows, sum product classes or convert product mass to nutrient mass without composition factors.

jobs.cadence: IPCC physical-science assessment release review.
jobs.provenance: Checksum-bound IPCC AR6 Chapter 7 author output retaining the exact 1990-2019 global annual aerosol-radiation, aerosol-cloud and total aerosol effective-radiative-forcing values needed for current loss and momentum.
jobs.uncertainty: Aerosol forcing is assessment-constrained rather than directly observed, aerosol-cloud interactions dominate uncertainty, and IPCC has low confidence in the magnitude of post-2014 change.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last checksum-validated assessment series and mark stale; reject changed columns, units, years or checksum; never substitute emissions, optical depth, projections or regional trends for global total aerosol forcing or fill missing years with zero.

jobs.cadence: Annual primary-study and assessment-update review.
jobs.provenance: Peer-reviewed global ocean temperature and salinity synthesis retaining checksum-bound 1960-2018 annual N-squared anomalies, source uncertainty bounds and an independent 1960-2024 multi-dataset review update.
jobs.uncertainty: Historical profile density, vertical resolution, interpolation, horizontal sampling, instrument bias, dataset construction and depth-layer selection affect estimates. The annual source workbook ends in 2018; the 2025 review supplies updated trend summaries rather than a replacement annual series.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last validated source workbook and mark stale; reject checksum, units, years, depths or uncertainty-column changes; never fill missing profiles with zero, combine projections with observations or infer local stratification from the global mean.

jobs.cadence: Annual FAO Global Soil Partnership assessment review.
jobs.provenance: Official FAO global annual arable-soil erosion and agricultural-production-loss estimates, retained in their source units and boundary.
jobs.uncertainty: Global estimates synthesize heterogeneous methods and landscapes; erosion, deposition, soil formation, wind and water processes and valuation assumptions vary. The summary provides no observation-level uncertainty interval or globally comparable annual trend.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed estimate and mark stale; reject changed units or boundaries; never infer remaining topsoil stock, apply a world average to a locality, fill missing uncertainty with zero or call the burden estimate a measured acceleration series.

jobs.cadence: Annual review for a comparable global flood-observation or exposure assessment.
jobs.provenance: Peer-reviewed global satellite observation of 913 large flood events during 2000-2018 paired with a World Bank-led 188-country, 1-in-100-year flood-zone population and poverty exposure assessment.
jobs.uncertainty: The observed event catalogue omits small, cloud-obscured and quality-control-failing floods; affected-population estimates are a range. The probability-zone assessment is modeled and protection, terrain, population and poverty inputs affect results. Neither source reports global asset value.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed pair and mark stale; reject changed event, country, time or hazard thresholds; never add observed affected people to modeled exposed people, treat exposure as annual victims, infer missing asset value or score future projections.

jobs.cadence: Annual Sendai Framework Monitor review.
jobs.provenance: Official UNDRR LDC status summary retaining the 2015-2024 period, mortality-rate and direct-loss-to-GDP comparisons, and reporting denominator.
jobs.uncertainty: Reporting definitions, valuation, national capacity and completeness vary; group comparisons do not measure household recovery, aid awards or causal discrimination.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; reject changed periods or missing denominators; never infer non-reporting as zero, apply group averages to households or combine rates into counts.

jobs.cadence: Annual after the FAO FishStat Global Production release.
jobs.provenance: Checksum-bound FAO FishStat capture quantities filtered to tonnes live weight, marine fishing areas and the SOFIA Fish, crustaceans and molluscs category.
jobs.uncertainty: National submissions and flags, unreported catch, area and species assignment, revisions and live-weight conversion affect totals; global stability can mask regional disruption.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last checksum-validated complete series and mark stale; reject changed filters or fewer than 20 baseline years; never combine inland capture or aquaculture, fill missing years with zero or infer local landings.

jobs.cadence: Annual primary-study and source-data release review; replace only with a comparable global in-situ aggregation.
jobs.provenance: Peer-reviewed annual-median groundwater-level analysis retaining about 170,000 wells, 1,693 aquifer systems, published trend bins, well-level Figure 1 source data and comparison subsets.
jobs.uncertainty: Monitoring density, record length, aquifer delineation and national coverage vary; wells are not a randomized global sample, withdrawal coverage is not land or aquifer coverage and level change is not storage volume.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed study and mark stale; reject changed denominators or source-data checksums; never infer volume, attribute all decline to pumping or treat unmonitored aquifers or wells as stable.

jobs.cadence: Annual literature and IPBES assessment review; replace only with a globally comparable updated burden study.
jobs.provenance: Peer-reviewed global crop-yield-gap, pollination-attribution, trade and comparative-risk assessment retaining estimates and uncertainty intervals separately.
jobs.uncertainty: Crop loss and mortality are modeled estimates; yield-gap attribution, trade, food waste, diet, risk functions and country data affect results, and no complete global pollinator trend is established.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; reject non-global studies; never score total pollination-dependent production as realized loss, treat uncertainty bounds as observations or infer global colony collapse.

jobs.cadence: Sendai Framework Monitor and Target D assessment release review.
jobs.provenance: Official UNDRR Target D assessment retaining annual-average damaged facilities, fixed-period service disruptions, reporting-country denominator and modeled losses separately.
jobs.uncertainty: Country reporting and definitions vary; pandemic-period service disruptions cannot all be attributed to physical damage and global annual loss is modeled.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed Target D assessment and mark stale; reject missing denominators; never infer unreported countries as zero, add facility and service counts or score modeled annual loss as observed.

jobs.cadence: Annual WMO global-climate update and UNEP coastal-exposure assessment review.
jobs.provenance: Official WMO observed global mean sea-level rates and current low-lying-coast exposure paired with UNEP current additional 1-in-20 annual coastal-flood exposure.
jobs.uncertainty: Exposure depends on elevation, population, protection and hazard models; preliminary sea-level data include natural variability and exposure is not realized loss.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment pair and mark stale; reject changed periods or probability boundaries; never add overlapping exposure, treat exposure as annual victims or score future projections as current impact.

jobs.cadence: IOC-UNESCO GO2NE assessment release review.
jobs.provenance: Official IOC-UNESCO synthesis retaining open-ocean low-oxygen area growth and inventoried coastal low-oxygen sites separately.
jobs.uncertainty: Coastal monitoring is geographically uneven; site inventories lack consistent area, duration, severity and cadence and cannot be summed into global area.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; reject changed dates or units; never convert sites to area, infer unmonitored coasts as oxygenated or combine open-ocean and coastal extents.

jobs.cadence: Global Wetland Outlook release review with annual Convention status check.
jobs.provenance: Official Convention on Wetlands global assessment retaining historical area loss, ongoing decline, remaining-condition share and accumulated service-value loss separately.
jobs.uncertainty: Wetland definitions, historical mapping, reporting coverage and economic valuation methods vary by type and region; valuation is not a market transaction.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; reject changed area or price-year boundaries; never relabel all wetland loss as agricultural drainage, add degraded and lost area or score projected loss as realized impact.

jobs.cadence: UNDRR GAR release review with annual drought-terminology and loss-estimate checks.
jobs.provenance: Official UNDRR global drought hazard assessment retaining recorded occurrence change, fixed-decade affected population and cost, modeled present annual loss and global-region scope separately.
jobs.uncertainty: Drought onset, duration, loss and affected-population reporting are incomplete and definition-sensitive; present annual loss is modeled rather than a reconciled observation inventory.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed GAR assessment and mark stale; reject changed periods or loss boundaries; never add overlapping affected populations, infer local SPI or score modeled annual loss as observed damage.

jobs.cadence: Annual WMO water-resource report and UN World Water Development Report release review.
jobs.provenance: Official WMO global glacier mass-balance assessment paired with the official UNESCO/UN-Water glacier-and-snow melt dependence assessment, retaining all measurement boundaries separately.
jobs.uncertainty: Mass-balance scaling, preliminary observations, regional coverage and human-dependence definitions affect estimates; the population figure includes snow melt and is not glacier-only supply share.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment pair and mark stale; reject missing mass units or region denominators; never relabel glacier-plus-snow dependence as glacier-only supply or realized shortage.

jobs.cadence: Annual Copernicus Marine OMI release check with full native-file checksum and series replacement.
jobs.provenance: Official Copernicus Marine global annual surface-ocean pH indicator, retaining the dataset release, complete time series, source uncertainty and native NetCDF checksum.
jobs.uncertainty: The series is a multi-observation reprocessing product; carbonate inputs, sampling sparsity, reconstruction, weighting, pH scale, coverage and revisions affect estimates.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last checksum-validated complete series and mark stale; reject schema changes, missing or duplicate years, implausible pH or fewer than 20 annual observations; never fill missing years with zero or infer aragonite saturation from pH.

jobs.cadence: Annual Review of Maritime Transport release with quarterly UNCTAD freight and chokepoint checks.
jobs.provenance: Official UNCTAD maritime-transport reviews retaining seaborne-trade exposure, rerouting ton-mile effects, port congestion context and freight-rate comparisons separately.
jobs.uncertainty: Freight indices cover selected routes; port calls are activity rather than congestion duration; routing, cargo mix, contracts, fuel, insurance and timing affect comparison.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed report pair and mark stale; never convert port calls to delay, attribute all freight inflation to ports or score projected consumer-price effects as realized losses.

jobs.cadence: Monthly WHO emergency-update check with complete-period replacement after the final epidemiological report.
jobs.provenance: Official WHO multi-country cholera emergency updates for near-complete reporting periods and WHO surveillance case-fatality benchmark.
jobs.uncertainty: Case definitions, surveillance, underreporting, verification, reporting delays, laboratory confirmation, community deaths and observation cutoffs affect comparison.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reconciled complete-period pair and mark stale; never infer absence from missing reports, relabel cholera/AWD as all waterborne disease or compare incomplete periods as full years.

jobs.cadence: Refresh on Aqueduct model releases and revalidate the global assessment page monthly.
jobs.provenance: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 global baseline-water-stress assessment retaining threshold definitions, country counts, population exposure, demand-change baseline and irrigated-agriculture exposure separately.
jobs.uncertainty: Modeled renewable supply, withdrawals, population allocation, return flows and country aggregation affect results; exposure is not realized household shortage.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last validated assessment and mark stale; reject changed thresholds or missing denominators; never treat exposure as observed shortage, classify missing places as zero stress or score future projections as current.

jobs.cadence: Daily source check with weekly validated snapshot replacement and event-status reconciliation.
jobs.provenance: Official NOAA Coral Reef Watch daily global 5 km bleaching-stress extent, documented global-event criteria, event-wide reef-area exposure and field-confirmed mass-bleaching jurisdiction count.
jobs.uncertainty: Satellite reef masks, climatology, product versions, heat-stress thresholds, field-report coverage and event start/end adjudication affect estimates; heat-stress extent is not colony mortality.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last validated snapshot and mark stale; reject missing criteria, invalid percentages, truncated history or changed basin denominator; never infer reef structural collapse or fill missing reef pixels with zero.

jobs.cadence: Refresh with each UNEP and UN-Water SDG 6.6.1 progress assessment.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed global SDG 6.6.1 findings for freshwater status, basin flow trends and exposed population, retaining country and basin denominators.
jobs.uncertainty: Country reporting, satellite coverage, basin delineation, trend significance, observation epochs and national indicator composition vary.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never add overlapping populations, turn one degraded type into total national collapse, infer causes from flow change or fill unreported ecosystems with zero.

jobs.cadence: Refresh when IPBES publishes a successor global biodiversity or invasive-alien-species assessment.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed IPBES Summary for Policymakers values, preserving assessment year, lower bounds, price year and attribution language. These are assessment syntheses, not occurrence-record trends.
jobs.uncertainty: Monitoring, models, red lists, economic studies, taxonomic and geographic coverage, extinction attribution and benefit valuation affect estimates; several findings are established but incomplete.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never derive intactness or invasion trends from raw occurrences, add overlapping extinction categories, turn contribution into sole causation or treat risk ranges as realized losses.

jobs.cadence: Refresh when WHO updates its global comparative-risk assessment, exposure estimate or air-quality guideline.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed WHO global exposure and attributable-burden statements. Ambient-only country rates remain in the separate operational GHO snapshot and are not summed without population weights.
jobs.uncertainty: Comparative-risk estimates combine modeled exposure, exposure-response functions, background burden and population data; ambient and household exposure overlap.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; reject incompatible exposure or mortality boundaries; never add ambient and household deaths, average country rates without population weights or fill missing estimates with zero.

jobs.cadence: Refresh when UNEP or UNEP-WCMC publishes a harmonized global blue-ecosystem assessment.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed UNEP global status values, including Global Mangrove Watch-derived change and separately bounded seagrass assessment evidence.
jobs.uncertainty: Historical baselines, habitat definitions, mapping, natural gains and losses, carbon methods, valuation and proximity-based population exposure affect estimates.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never derive area loss from occurrence records, add habitat areas, equate proximity with individual dependence or score future risk as observed loss.

jobs.cadence: Annual refresh after NASA finalizes the Antarctic ozone-hole season.
jobs.provenance: Official NASA Ozone Watch TOMS, OMI and OMPS annual records with fixed seasonal windows, area below 220 DU and minimum mean ozone retained separately; the missing 1995 year remains absent.
jobs.uncertainty: Polar-vortex dynamics, temperature, aerosols, sunlight, transport, sensor transitions, missing-orbit assimilation and fixed seasonal windows affect annual values.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last validated complete season and mark stale; reject schema changes, duplicates or histories below 20 years. Never fill 1995, count an incomplete season or interpret a polar season as uniform global recovery.

jobs.cadence: Refresh with each annual IEA Global Critical Minerals Outlook and Global EV Outlook.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed IEA current-period global battery demand, demand growth, manufacturing capacity and production-concentration values; future scenarios are excluded from scoring.
jobs.uncertainty: Estimated battery size, sales, storage applications, proprietary inputs, stockpiling exclusions, trade, ownership and chemistry changes affect estimates. Capacity is not production.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; reject mixed units or boundaries; never count announced capacity as operating supply, treat projections as current or equate concentration with realized disruption.

jobs.cadence: Refresh with each annual SOFI release after reconciling revised historical estimates.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed SOFI 2025 estimates for 2024 global hunger, moderate or severe food insecurity and healthy-diet affordability, retaining reported uncertainty and comparison intervals.
jobs.uncertainty: SOFI combines surveys, models, population estimates and affordability calculations. Rounded people counts, revisions and different indicator definitions affect comparison.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; reject changed definitions or years; never add overlapping populations, replace missing regions with zero or count projections as current.

jobs.cadence: Refresh when the World Bank publishes a new global desalination assessment.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed World Bank global plant, country, population and installed-capacity assessment values, retaining the rounded regional share behind the derived global capacity.
jobs.uncertainty: Plant databases change rapidly; the capacity total is derived from rounded values and people supplied is approximate rather than a utility-level denominator.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never infer country supply share, treat installed capacity as production, transfer case-study energy intensity globally, or replace absent country data with zero.

jobs.cadence: Refresh when IEA updates Energy and AI or its Energy and AI Observatory.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed IEA current global data-centre electricity, electricity share, five-year growth, indirect power emissions and investment; scenarios remain labeled projections.
jobs.uncertainty: IEA reports substantial uncertainty around current and future demand; facility coverage, utilization, electricity mix, investment accounting and rapid technology change affect estimates.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never count projections as current, infer AI-only electricity from the total, add backup-generator emissions, or treat missing facilities as zero.

jobs.cadence: Refresh with each FAO State of World Fisheries and Aquaculture release.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed FAO global production, consumption, nutrition, employment and regional-distribution values, retaining aquatic animals and algae separately where reported.
jobs.uncertainty: Informal production, trade allocation, apparent-consumption accounting, population denominators and revisions affect values; reliance is not itself evidence of ecological damage.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never infer household intake from apparent consumption, treat aquaculture as capture fisheries, merge algae into aquatic-animal consumption, or convert missing regions to zero.

jobs.cadence: Refresh with each UNEP Global Cooling Watch release.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed UNEP current baseline and access-gap values for global cooling capacity, emissions and people lacking adequate cooling; future pathways remain labeled projections.
jobs.uncertainty: Cooling-access definitions vary and current emissions are modeled sector estimates; the report does not attribute all heat deaths to absent cooling or supply a country-level access denominator.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never count projected outcomes as current, infer protection from equipment ownership, attribute all heat deaths to cooling access, or convert missing countries to zero.

jobs.cadence: Refresh with each UNECE-UNESCO SDG indicator 6.5.2 reporting cycle.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed official 2023 monitoring-cycle country counts, global indicator average and transboundary-water share, retaining each measure separately.
jobs.uncertainty: National reports vary in completeness, aquifer delineation and interpretation of operationality; the metric measures cooperation coverage rather than conflict.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed cycle and mark stale; never convert non-reporting countries to zero, infer conflict from a cooperation gap or treat basin-area coverage as population exposure.

jobs.cadence: Annual after ICAO publishes the World of Air Transport results.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed ICAO preliminary global passenger, departure, RPK and freight statistics for 2024; environmental burden remains in the separate EDGAR aviation series.
jobs.uncertainty: ICAO labels 2024 statistics preliminary; scheduled-service coverage, revisions and traffic definitions affect values.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed report and mark stale; never treat forecasts as observations, convert activity directly to fuel or CO2, add passenger and freight quantities or replace missing reporting with zero.

jobs.cadence: Annual after IEA Breakthrough Agenda and Renewables reports are published.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed global steel-route, near-zero capacity, cement-transition and industrial renewable-heat values; announced and scenario quantities stay labeled.
jobs.uncertainty: Route definitions, project maturity, cost assumptions and heat accounting vary; announced capacity can be delayed or cancelled.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never treat announced capacity, targets or forecasts as current production, infer plant performance or add incompatible sector quantities.

jobs.cadence: Annual after IEA Global Critical Minerals Outlook publication.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed IEA current 2024 demand-growth and supply-concentration findings; forecasts remain excluded from current burden components.
jobs.uncertainty: Mineral definitions, mined/refined boundaries, stock changes and project timing affect values; concentration is vulnerability, not realized disruption.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed report and mark stale; never count forecasts as current, add mineral growth rates, infer site-level harm or convert missing mineral series to zero.

jobs.cadence: Refresh with new UNEP-WCMC connectivity or FAO FRA releases.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed global structural-connectivity shares joined to FAO forest-loss history only as persistence and service-scope context.
jobs.uncertainty: Structural connectivity does not prove functional movement, occupancy, gene flow or population benefit; FAO forest designations are not fragmentation observations.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never infer species-specific movement, add overlapping designations, attribute all forest loss to fragmentation or treat unreported areas as zero.

jobs.cadence: Refresh when a method-comparable global free-flowing-river assessment is published.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed primary global assessment values; inland-fisheries population is retained only as exposed service scope.
jobs.uncertainty: Barrier inventories, river resolution, index thresholds, natural barriers and tributary treatment affect classification.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never infer barrier counts, local passability, focal-species loss or household harm from the global share.

jobs.cadence: Annual after WHO/UNICEF JMP release.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed JMP global 2024 service estimates and 2000-2024 trend interval; service ladder categories remain separate.
jobs.uncertainty: The safely managed gap combines accessibility, availability and quality dimensions and does not isolate hydrologic supply or treatment capacity.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed release and mark stale; never add nested service categories, infer rationing or treatment failure, or replace missing countries with zero.

jobs.cadence: Refresh when a method-comparable authoritative global estimate is published.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed World Bank global annual non-revenue-water volume and economic loss; components are not reclassified as physical leakage.
jobs.uncertainty: The estimate is older and combines physical and commercial losses; utility coverage and valuation vary.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never treat all non-revenue water as leakage, infer city performance or convert missing utilities to zero.

jobs.cadence: Refresh when UNEP or FAO publishes a new global sustainable food cold-chain assessment.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed joint UNEP-FAO global values for food loss attributable to inadequate refrigeration, associated emissions, farmer income impact and developing-country savings potential.
jobs.uncertainty: The report synthesizes estimates with differing methods and years; values are assessment quantities rather than monitored global incidents or consignment excursions.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; never infer a monthly trend, affected consignments, temperature-excursion duration, country allocation or food-safety illness count.

jobs.cadence: Refresh when UNEP publishes a new global peatland assessment or hotspot atlas.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed UNEP global assessment, hotspot-atlas and economics values for damaged share, annual loss, emissions contribution, remediation financing and country extent.
jobs.uncertainty: Global mapping and condition inventories remain incomplete; assessment years and methods differ; required investment is remediation financing rather than observed economic damage.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; reject changed units or unreconciled geography counts; never infer burned area, affected population, realized monetary damage or a continuous annual history.

jobs.cadence: Refresh when UNEP publishes a new Food Waste Index global assessment.
jobs.provenance: Reviewed UNEP Food Waste Index Report 2024 global assessment values for household, food-service and retail waste, including mass, per-capita burden, food-availability share, environmental burden and economic cost.
jobs.uncertainty: Country estimates include extrapolation where primary studies are absent; retail and food-service uncertainty is substantial; manufacturing is omitted; assessment editions are not interpreted as a measured trend.
jobs.failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed report snapshot and mark stale; never treat unmeasured countries or sectors as zero, compare editions as a trend without harmonization, or extend consumer-facing estimates to manufacturing.

jobs.cadence: Annual complete-release refresh after Ember updates its Yearly Electricity Data file.
